department: Department of Electrical and Computer Engineering

deadline.value: Applications for fellowship consideration must arrive before November 30 (from the department FAQ; the current admissions page was blocked).
deadline.quote: To be considered for a fellowship, applications (with the box marked "fellowship" checked) must be received before November 30.

gre_general.value: A GRE score is not required for admission to ECE, though any scores submitted are considered.
gre_general.quote: A GRE score is not required for admission to ECE, though any scores submitted will be considered.

supervisor.value: PhD applicants are told to email faculty about advising opportunities; some find advisors after arrival, and an advisor is needed by the end of the second semester.
supervisor.quote: Email the faculty member(s) to inquire about advising opportunities.

also.quote: All PhD students are required to have a faculty advisor by the end of their 2nd semester of enrollment.

funding.value: Fellowships are awarded by competition and GRA positions depend on faculty project funds; GTA positions are awarded by the department.
funding.quote: Fellowships are awarded through a rigorous university-wide competition.

also.quote: GRA appointments are awarded as grant money becomes available.

entry_route.value: You can apply to the direct BS-to-PhD program.
entry_route.quote: Yes, you may apply to the direct BS to PhD program.

gre_subject.value: No GRE Subject Test exists for this field; ETS offers Subject Tests only in Mathematics, Physics and Psychology.
gre_subject.quote: The GRE Subject Tests in Mathematics, Physics and Psychology measure undergraduate achievement in a particular field of study

notes: The department admissions page (ece.osu.edu/graduate-admissions) returned 403; values come from an older FAQ.
